method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Local Government Act 1995 (No. 74 of 1995), mrdoc 49599 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49599.txt; no compilation date stated; Part 6 notes run to No. 7 of 2026. No regulations deposited: the prescribed maximum interest rate (s 6.51(2)), maximum instalment charge (s 6.45(4)(e)), interest method (s 6.51(5)) and minimum payment limits (s 6.35(4)) are inputs or not encoded. The Local Government (COVID-19 Response) Order 2020 modifications (SL 2020/57) are not applied.

scope: From the seat of the ratepayer, for the WA lives (Chloe c055; Daniel d084): Part 6 Division 6 -- s 6.26(1)-(2) (rateable land); s 6.28 (gross rental value or unimproved value: the Minister's determination, the rural/non-rural principle answered conditionally; the 1 July valuation or a later interim valuation); ss 6.32(1)-(2), 6.35(1) (general rate in the dollar, minimum payment, specified area rate, service charge); s 6.33(3)-(4); s 6.36(3) (21 days); ss 6.39(2), 6.40(1), (3) (reassessment, refund or credit); s 6.41 (rate notice, email, deemed service, 28 days); ss 6.43, 6.44 (charge on land; joint and several); s 6.45 (single payment or 4 instalments; remaining instalments; instalment charge); s 6.46; s 6.50 (35 days; 2 months between instalments); s 6.51 (interest by resolution, prescribed maximum an input, simple daily interest assumed; none for a rebate or deferment entitlement); ss 6.52, 6.53, 6.55, 6.56, 6.60, 6.61 ($5,000), 6.62; ss 6.64(1), (3), 6.67(1), 6.69; ss 6.76, 6.77, 6.78, 6.80, 6.81, 6.82 (objections, 42 days; valuations under the Valuation of Land Act 1978). Pensioner and seniors rebates and deferments: pointer to the Rates and Charges (Rebates and Deferments) Act 1992, not encoded. Not encoded: Divisions 1-5, mining and petroleum land (ss 6.26(2A), 6.27, 6.29, 6.30), Schedule 6.1 phasing, ss 6.34, 6.35(2)-(6), 6.37-6.38 uses, sale and transfer procedure (ss 6.65-6.75, Schedules 6.2, 6.3).
seat: the ratepayer (the owner of rateable land)
